implementation: Host debug adapter over portable actual-source/erasure/print observations; no tsc invocation.
subjects: Optional original-source preparation map and caller-pinned source snapshot
mappingPolicy: Reconstruct lineage and optional original-source preparation before consuming any edge.
Convert actual source byte offsets to LF-delimited zero-based lines and UTF-16 columns; never reuse scalar parser columns.
Use binary search on reconstructed copied segments for original byte anchors; removed source gaps are not widened.
Map declaration chunk start only through its first generated line; unmap at the first line terminator or chunk end.
Explicitly unmap the module prefix and intervening/synthetic code; do not invent EOF character mappings.
Encode signed 32-bit ECMA-426 VLQ using arithmetic, with source/original deltas retained across lines and generated-column reset only.
Terminate mapping lines explicitly, including the last nonempty line; the permitted final empty line avoids terminal unmapped-segment ambiguity in the pinned Node consumer.
Embed exact sourcesContent; source URLs are relative escaped display names. Do not infer token-level symbol names.
